Researchers work on alignment through techniques like reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), where humans provide feedback to guide the AI's behavior, and other methods.

While some researchers have raised concerns about potential risks from misaligned AI, these challenges are actively being addressed through ongoing research, and many experts believe continued progress will ensure AI remains beneficial.
